## Ridge Flier (CR 1)

**XP** 300  
N Small animal  
**Init** +0; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +6  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +2 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 11 (2d8+2)  
**Fort** +4, **Ref** +6, **Will** +3  


**Offense**


**Speed** 10 ft., fly 80 ft. (average)  
**Melee** bite +4 (1d4+1)  
**Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  


**Statistics**


**STR** 12, **Dex** 17, **Con** 12, **Int** 1, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 10  
**Base Attack** +1; **CMB** +1, **CMD** 14  
**Feats** Weapon Finesse  
**Skills** Fly +7, Perception +6; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception  
**SQ** sense intruder, hyper-aggression  


**Special Abilities**


**Sense Intruder (Ex)** Ridge fliers have a preternatural ability to sense when a creature has entered their territory. A ridge flier gains a +20 bonus to Perception checks to notice the presence of a creature nearby. This only allows them to know there is a creature within 100 feet of them, they must make a standard Perception check (without the bonus) to pinpoint the intruder.  

**Hyper-aggression (Ex)** If a ridge flier spots a creature that they do not recognize as part of their flock or other individual they are trained to accept, there is a 10% chance every minute that they will fly into a rage and attack the invading creature. The ridge flier gains a +2 bonus to Strength and Constitution, a +8 bonus to Perception to find the target of its rage, and a -2 penalty to its AC. The rage lasts until the creature is dead or 1 minute, whichever is shorter. The ridge flier cannot end this rage voluntarily.
